messages:
sarah: Quick sync — postmortem follow-ups from last night

sarah: TL;DR: recurring 02:00 UTC surge exhausted quota in the eu-west dedicated pool, scheduler fell behind, autoscaler failed to trigger fast enough. I sketched owners + dates below. please ack and flag if you need different timelines.

jake: ack, will take quota action. filing cloud support ticket today. ETA 2026-04-01 for the request to be approved.

tamika: ack. I can take scheduler tuning. plan: run a canary with reduced preemption threshold and tighter backoff.

ops-bot: incident-bot: created follow-up ticket INF-4821 (gpu-capacity-remediation). linked to postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-gpu-surge

rahul: question — is the primary failure the quota limit or a cache-induced latency spike that prevented autoscaler signals?

sarah: good call. evidence shows both. quota hit was the triggering event; cache pressure + long KV GC cycles amplified scheduler latency so scale signals were delayed.

mira: I'll add a headroom widget to the Console (per-route capacity + expected burst buffer) so product owners can see risk windows. ETA 2026-03-30.

jake: action 1: quota request (owner=jake, task=file quota increase & cloud support follow-ups, due=2026-04-01). ticket INF-4822.

tamika: action 2: scheduler canary (owner=tamika, task=deploy canary with preemption_threshold=0.15 and autoscaler.min_replicas bump, due=2026-03-28). I'll run 24h soak.

rahul: action 3: KV cache postmortem (owner=rahul, task=identify GC hotspots + propose config fix or TTL changes, due=2026-03-27).

mira: action 4: Console headroom panel (owner=mira, task=add 3 visualizations: per-region headroom, expected 95th percentile burst, and quota burn rate, due=2026-03-30).

sarah: action 5: runbook update (owner=sarah, task=add surge checklist: preflight quota check, canary launch steps, escalation matrix, due=2026-03-26).

jake: I opened cloud ticket with priority P2 and attached load windows + traces. link: https://console.cloud.provider/support/req/12345

ops-bot: incident-bot: scheduled recurring follow-up reminder every weekday at 10:00 UTC until INF-4821 is closed.

tamika: quick config snippet I'll test on canary:
```
# scheduler tuning for canary
scheduler.preemption_threshold=0.15
scheduler.max_backoff_seconds=30
autoscaler.scale_up_stabilization=60
```

rahul: for KV GC I'll start with a 2x sampling increase and capture p99 latencies during soak. will post results in INF-4823.

mira: added a low-fidelity mockup of the headroom widget to the design board: https://figma.com/file/abcd-headroom-mock

sarah: next sync: Friday 09:00 UTC. please update your ticket entries before then. if any owner cannot meet the due date, call it out now. :white_check_mark:

jake: small risk: cloud may ask for justification docs. I'll prep usage graphs and cost impact note.

tamika: noted. if quota increase is delayed, plan B is to temporarily raise autoscaler aggressiveness for burst windows and pin lower-priority workloads. I'll draft the emergency run commands.

rahul: acked. posting initial KV traces later today.

mira: ack, will push the widget prototype to staging once I have the API endpoints.

sarah: thanks all — I'll consolidate into a single action tracker and ping owners tomorrow.

jake: :thumbsup:

ops-bot: incident-bot: INF-4821 status: in-progress. owners: jake, tamika, rahul, mira, sarah.
